info.title: HNN Biller — Complete API
info.description:
Every endpoint across all feature groups.

### Editions
Every client runs on one of two editions in the **same deployment**:

| Edition | Includes |
|---|---|
| `non_commercial` | Billing, payer routing, patient payments, dashboard, notifications, medical reports |
| `commercial` | Everything above **plus** revenue rules & other charges, financing, NHIS ClaimIt tracker, agnostic payer tabs, audit ledger |

Switching is a per-client flag flip — no redeploy, no data migration, and **nothing is deleted on downgrade**.
Commercial-only endpoints return **402 `upgrade_required`** when the caller's client is non-commercial.
Check your own entitlement any time with `GET /api/v1/bills/edition`.

**Base URL:** `https://nextgenhnnbiller-production.up.railway.app`

get.description: Drive your own configuration UI from this — caps and targets are authoritative and enforced server-side.

put.description:
Percentage rules: `expedited_settlement` (cap 15%), `discount_fee` (cap 15%), `claimit_margin` (cap 100% of cashback) — send `rate` (0–1 or 0–100; clamped to the cap).

Flat "other charges": `report_fee_mini`, `report_fee_standard` — send `amount` in GHS.
